description: This file defines the IBasketService interface, which specifies the contract for basket-related operations such as adding items, transferring baskets, setting quantities, and deleting baskets within the eShop Web application.

classes.name: IBasketService
classes.description: Interface defining basket operations such as adding items, transferring, setting quantities, and deleting baskets.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers a basket from an anonymous identifier to a user name.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the basket for a specified user, with a given catalog item ID, price, and quantity.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets the quantities for items in the basket, identified by basket ID, using a dictionary of item IDs and quantities.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes the basket identified by the given basket ID.
